svg.title: The workflow said Complete. The data was still there.
svg.desc: Three scenes. One: a person asks to have everything about them deleted, and the workflow stamps it Complete. Two: the agent checks every copy of their data with a magnifying glass and finds a ghost of the data hiding in a backup. Three: the agent hands back a report saying Not complete, with what it found, how to fix it, and how to check the fix.
svg.text: An AI agent that checks whether a person’s data is really gone, from every copy.
3. A verdict and a fix-it plan
